program:
app "Shop Stock" bag ocean
table item name text, buy money, sell money, qty num 0..
table sale item ref item, n num 1..
setting low num = 5 "Low stock level"
let sold = sum(sale today, it.n * it.item.sell)
let profit = sum(sale today, it.n * (it.item.sell - it.item.buy))
row gap 3
  stat sold, "sales today"
  stat profit, "profit today"
each item where qty <= low sort name
  row card
    "Low stock:" it.name it.qty color bad
each item sort name
  row card gap 1
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      "Buy" it.buy "Sell" it.sell faint
    it.qty bold color if(it.qty <= low, bad, ink)
    button "Sell 1" tap add sale item = it, n = 1 then set it.qty = it.qty - 1
form item, "Add item"
describe:
Shop Stock, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- item: name: text; buy: money; sell: money; qty: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- sale: item: a item; n: number, at least 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Low stock level": number, starts at 5.
Works out:
- sold is the sum of its n times its item sell over the sale today.
- profit is the sum of its n times the result of its item sell minus its item buy over the sale today.
Shows:
- a big number: sold, labelled "sales today".
- a big number: profit, labelled "profit today".
- for each item where qty is at most low sorted by name:
  - text: "Low stock:", its name, its qty.
- for each item sorted by name:
  - text: its name.
  - text: "Buy", its buy, "Sell", its sell.
  - text: its qty.
  - a button "Sell 1"; a tap adds a sale with item set to the item, n set to 1, then sets its qty to its qty minus 1.
- a form to add a item.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one

program:
app "Darts" target mint
table point team pick Mum|Dad, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Mum)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Dad)
setting winat num = 301 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Mum" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Mum, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Mum, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Mum, pts = 3
  stack card grow align center
    "Dad" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 3
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Mum win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Dad win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
describe:
Darts, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Mum, Dad; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 301.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Mum.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Dad.
Shows:
- text: "Mum".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Mum, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Mum, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Mum, pts set to 3.
- text: "Dad".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Dad, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Dad, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Dad, pts set to 3.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Mum win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Dad win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.

program:
app "Daily Tic tac toe" board ink
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1
describe:
Daily Tic tac toe, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- move: game: number; cell: number, 1 to 9; mark: one of X, O. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Game": number, starts at 1.
Works out:
- n is how many move entries where game is cur.
- turn is "X" when n leaves over when divided by 2 is 0, otherwise "O".
- xw is the result of how many of 123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357 have how many move entries where game is cur and mark is "X" and the result of cell is the value divided by 100 rounded down or cell is the value divided by 10 rounded down leaves over when divided by 10 or cell is the value leaves over when divided by 10 is 3 is more than 0.
- ow is the result of how many of 123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357 have how many move entries where game is cur and mark is "O" and the result of cell is the value divided by 100 rounded down or cell is the value divided by 10 rounded down leaves over when divided by 10 or cell is the value leaves over when divided by 10 is 3 is more than 0.
Shows:
- if xw or ow:
  - text: "X" when xw, otherwise "O", "wins!".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Draw" when n is 9, otherwise turn, "" when n is 9, otherwise "to play".
- a grid of 3 columns:
  - for each number from 1 to 9:
    - if how many move entries where game is cur and cell is the number is 0 and not xw and not ow:
      - a group; a tap adds a move with game set to cur, cell set to the number, mark set to turn:
    - otherwise:
      - text: the latest mark of move where game is cur and cell is the number.
- a button "New game"; a tap sets cur to cur plus 1.

setting target num = 7
let n = count(floss today)
draw width 240 tap add floss
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
button "Undo" tap remove last(floss today)
button "Reset today" tap remove all floss today
stat count(floss), "all time"
stat streak(floss), "day streak"
describe:
Dentist floss, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- floss: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: target: number, starts at 7.
Works out:
- n is how many floss entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a floss.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest floss entries today, with undo.
- a button "Reset today"; a tap removes all floss entries today, with one undo.
- a big number: how many floss entries, labelled "all time".
- a big number: the current day streak of floss entries, labelled "day streak".
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Reading List" book plum
table book title text, author text, pages num 1..5000, started date?
table finish book ref book, rating num 1..5
"Finished this year" count(finish year) big
"Average rating" round(avg(finish.rating year) * 10) / 10 head
"Pages read per month" head
bars 0..5, sum(finish month of addmonths(today, -it), it.book.pages), monthname(addmonths(today, -it))
each book sort title
  row card
    stack grow
      it.title bold
      it.author it.pages "pages" faint
    if(count(it.finish) > 0, "Finished", "Reading") color if(count(it.finish) > 0, good, muted)
    button "Finished" tap add finish book = it, rating = 3
form book, "Add book"
list finish
describe:
Reading List, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- book: title: text; author: text; pages: number, 1 to 5000; started: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- finish: book: a book; rating: number, 1 to 5. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Finished this year", how many finish entries this year.
- text: "Average rating", the average rating of finish this year times 10 rounded divided by 10.
- text: "Pages read per month".
- a bar chart of the sum of its book pages over the finish in the month of today moved by minus the item months for each of number from 0 to 5.
- for each book sorted by title:
  - text: its title.
  - text: its author, its pages, "pages".
  - text: "Finished" when how many its finish entries is more than 0, otherwise "Reading".
  - a button "Finished"; a tap adds a finish with book set to the book, rating set to 3.
- a form to add a book.
- a list of finish; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: terse like a search query, 2 to 6 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Homework" school slate
table homework title text, done bool, tag pick Maths|English|Science|Other = Maths, priority pick Low|Normal|High = Normal, due date?
count(homework where done = no) "open" head
each homework where done = no sort priority desc as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.tag t.due small color if(t.due < today, bad, muted)
form homework
"Done" faint
list homework where done = yes
button "Clear done" tap remove all homework where done = yes
remind "Check your homework" at 8:00
describe:
Homework, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- homework: title: text; done: yes or no; tag: one of Maths, English, Science, Other, starts at Maths; priority: one of Low, Normal, High, starts at Normal; due: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many homework entries where done is no, "open".
- for each homework where done is no sorted by priority, highest first:
  - a group; a tap opens the homework for editing; a swipe removes the homework, with undo:
    - a tick box for the done of the homework.
    - text: the title of the homework.
    - text: the tag of the homework, the due of the homework.
- a form to add a homework.
- text: "Done".
- a list of homework where done is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- a button "Clear done"; a tap removes all homework entries where done is yes, with one undo.
Reminder "Check your homework" at 8:00 every day.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one

program:
app "Medicine cabinet" pill plum
table med_item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen, expires date?
let short = count(med_item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "medicines running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each med_item sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(med_item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form med_item
describe:
Medicine cabinet, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- med item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3; price: money, optional; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the med item have its qty is at most its low.
Shows:
- text: short, "medicines running low".
- for each med item sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the med item for editing; a swipe removes the med item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the med item.
    - text: the kind of the med item.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the med item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the med item to the qty of the med item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the med item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the med item to the qty of the med item plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the med item.
- a form to add a med item.

fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words

program:
app "Tuition centre" school ocean
table student name text, level pick Class_6|Class_7|Class_8|Class_9|Class_10 = Class_6, fee money
table payment student ref student, amount money
screen fees "Fees" coin
  "Collected this month" sum(payment.amount month) big
  each student sort name as s
    let due = s.fee - sum(s.payment.amount month)
    row card gap 2
      stack grow
        s.name bold
        s.level faint
      due bold color if(due > 0, bad, good)
      button "Got fee" tap add payment student = s, amount = s.fee
screen roster "Students" users
  form student, "Add student"
  list student
describe:
Tuition centre, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- student: name: text; level: one of Class 6, Class 7, Class 8, Class 9, Class 10, starts at Class 6; fee: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- payment: student: a student; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a screen "Fees":
  - text: "Collected this month", the total amount of payment this month.
  - for each student sorted by name:
    - text: the name of the student.
    - text: the level of the student.
    - text: due.
    - a button "Got fee"; a tap adds a payment with student set to the student, amount set to the fee of the student.
- a screen "Students":
  - a form to add a student.
  - a list of student; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
